channel.title: The Counter Guide: buyer guides
channel.description: Buyer questions for kitchen appliances, with every listing checked against its source

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Shape decides how much room you need and what you can cook at once. Here is what the register shows for each shape, and what it does not show.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity is written in different ways. This checklist shows how to read it on a listing before you compare two units.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Dishwasher-safe parts save time, but they do not tell you how much counter the unit takes up. Here is how to check both.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function appliances bundle many jobs into one box. These are the questions to answer from the listing before you buy.

item.title: Instant-read or wireless: which meat thermometer fits your grill?
item.description: One-second reads vs. leave-in probes with WiFi — pick by how you cook. What the register shows, and what it does not.
